newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 9,700 slaughter steers and 6,000 heifers; 87,400 head confirmed for the week to date including 20,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00-63.25, mostly 63.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 62.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00, small pen 63.25. Pen Select and Choice 2-4 1250 lb
Wk to date - 87,400 Week Ago - 128,900 Year Ago - 27,800
